pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce the RSI Assistant application, its purpose for preventing repetitive strain injury, and provide a high-level architectural overview of the Tauri-based desktop application

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Guide developers through setting up the development environment, installing dependencies, and running the application for the first time

pages.title: High-Level Architecture
pages.purpose: Explain the three-tier architecture (Frontend/Tauri IPC/Backend), the tech stack choices (React, Rust, Tauri), and how the components communicate

pages.title: Frontend Architecture
pages.purpose: Comprehensive documentation of the React/TypeScript frontend, including component structure, state management patterns, and UI implementation

pages.title: Main Application Component
pages.purpose: Document the App.tsx component, its tab-based navigation system, window context detection (main vs overlay), and event handling for backend navigation

pages.title: Timer Display Component
pages.purpose: Explain the TimerDisplay component's circular progress indicators, time formatting, overdue state visualization, and manual break trigger functionality

pages.title: Break Overlay System
pages.purpose: Document the BreakOverlay component's modal interface, automatic completion logic, skip functionality, and IPC interactions for recording break events

pages.title: Settings Interface
pages.purpose: Describe the Settings component's form handling, multi-source configuration loading (local store → backend → defaults), immediate mode updates, and persistence strategy

pages.title: Statistics Dashboard
pages.purpose: Document the Statistics component's data visualization using Recharts, calendar navigation with react-calendar, break metrics tables, and historical data display

pages.title: State Management with useTimer Hook
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the useTimer hook's implementation, its initialization via get_timer_state, real-time updates via timer-update events, and null state handling during loading

pages.title: Styling System
pages.purpose: Explain the Tailwind CSS configuration, utility-first approach, custom CSS properties for theming, responsive design patterns, and dark mode support

pages.title: Type Definitions
pages.purpose: Document the core TypeScript interfaces (TimerStatus, BreakConfig, OperationMode, BreakType) that define the data contracts between frontend and backend

pages.title: Backend Architecture
pages.purpose: Comprehensive documentation of the Rust backend, including core services, timer logic, idle detection, and statistics management

pages.title: Application Entry Point and Initialization
pages.purpose: Document lib.rs setup function, plugin initialization, permission checks for IdleDetector, system tray menu creation, and background task spawning

pages.title: TimerService: Core Timer Logic
pages.purpose: Explain TimerService's tick mechanism, BreakConfig parameters, OperationMode state machine (Normal/Quiet/Suspended), break target tracking, and overdue detection algorithms

pages.title: Idle Detection System
pages.purpose: Document the IdleDetector trait, DeviceQueryIdleDetector implementation with background polling thread, accessibility permission requirements, and input device monitoring

pages.title: Statistics Store
pages.purpose: Describe StatsStore's DailyStats structure, metrics tracking (prompted/natural/skipped/postponed for each break type), persistence strategy, and historical queries

pages.title: Background Task and Event Loop
pages.purpose: Detail the 1-second polling loop, coordination between IdleDetector/TimerService/StatsStore, auto-break triggering logic, notification sending, and timer-update event emission

pages.title: Tauri Integration Layer
pages.purpose: Document the IPC bridge between frontend and backend, including command invocation patterns, event streaming, and Tauri plugin usage

pages.title: Command API (IPC)
pages.purpose: List and document all Tauri commands in commands.rs: get_timer_state, update_settings, get_settings, get_statistics, record_break_taken, record_break_postponed, reset_break, set_mode, trigger_break

pages.title: Event System
pages.purpose: Document the timer-update event stream, navigate-to events for view switching, and event listener patterns in the frontend

pages.purpose: Explain main vs overlay window contexts, window show/hide/focus operations, always-on-top behavior for break overlays, and window label detection

pages.title: System Tray Integration
pages.purpose: Document system tray menu structure, menu event handling, mode switching submenu, manual break triggers, and navigation-to events

pages.title: Capabilities and Permissions

pages.title: Data Flow and State Synchronization
pages.purpose: Explain how data flows through the application, from configuration loading through runtime state updates to statistics persistence.

pages.purpose: Detail the three-tier configuration precedence (local store → backend → defaults), Settings component's load/save flow, and immediate vs batch updates
